info.description:
REST API of buildoor, the Ethereum builder testing tool: status,
settings, per-slot action plans and outcomes, builder keys, the
transaction pool and registrations. Mutating endpoints need a
login (Bearer token) when an auth provider is configured. The
Builder API (/eth/v1/builder) and the JSON-RPC ingress (/rpc)
follow their own specifications and are not listed here. The
pre-v1 paths stay served as deprecated aliases until 2.0.
info.title: Buildoor API

get.description: Returns all per-slot action plans within the inclusive slot range.

post.description:
Applies a bulk per-slot action plan mutation atomically (all
targeted slots update or none). Category members are
three-state (absent = unchanged, null = clear, object =
replace); the "set" member supports fine-grained path updates
like {"bid.bid_min_amount": 5000} for partial edits. Updates
targeting past or already-frozen slots fail with 409.
Requires authentication.

409.description: Slot in the past or frozen

get.description:
Returns the recurring slot rules, id-ascending (which is also
their match order). A rule applies its categories to every slot
whose index within the epoch matches, unless the slot carries
an explicit plan.

post.description:
Atomically replaces the whole recurring rule set (every rule
validates or nothing changes). Each rule matches slot indices
within an epoch, optionally bounded to an epoch window, and
carries the same categories as a slot plan — e.g. win slot 31
of every epoch and withhold its payload. Already frozen slots
keep the plan they froze with. Requires authentication.
post.summary: Replace the recurring action plan rules

post.description:
Runs an operator jq expression against a sample payload / bid /
envelope (a captured artifact when sample_slot is given and
available, otherwise a zero-value template of the object) and
returns the transformed JSON, so expressions can be built and
tested live before being saved to a slot plan. Bid and envelope
transforms operate on the MESSAGE, matching production.
post.summary: Evaluate a jq transform against a sample builder object

parameters.description: Target, expression and optional sample slot
parameters.name: request

get.description: Returns a paginated list of authenticated mutating actions. Empty when no state-db is configured.
Returns a paginated list of won blocks (Builder API and p2p ePBS) with transaction counts, blob counts, and values, read from the shared inclusion tracker.
get.summary: Get bids won (blocks of ours included on chain)

get.description: Returns the current status of the Builder API including configuration and validator count.

Returns every managed builder key with its lifecycle status,
on-chain builder index, balances and usage history, plus fleet
aggregates and the mutable key-set settings.
get.summary: Get the managed builder key set

post.description:
Sets how many builder keys are kept registered and funded.
Raising it deposits new keys; lowering it exits surplus keys
when auto-exit is on — an exited key can never be reactivated.
post.summary: Set the target builder key count

post.description:
Submits a builder deposit for the given key and waits for it to
register on the beacon chain.

400.description: Invalid key index or deposit failed

post.description:
Submits a builder exit request for the given key. Irreversible:
an exited key cannot be reactivated until its registry entry is
reused by another builder's deposit. With lower_target the
target key count is decremented in the same write, so the
reconciler does not deposit a replacement.

Submits a top-up deposit for the given key when its balance is
below the configured threshold.

400.description: Invalid key index or top-up failed

get.description: Returns the buildoor configuration in use. Keys, secrets and the client endpoints are left out; the credentials in the RPC upstream URLs are masked.

patch.description:
Applies partial global settings updates keyed by canonical
settings paths (e.g. {"epbs.bid_subsidy": 1000,
"schedule.mode": "all"}) without requiring full config
objects. Unknown keys are rejected. The module enable flags
(epbs_enabled, builder_api_enabled, lifecycle_enabled) are
settings too; enabling a module this instance cannot run is
refused. Requires authentication.
patch.summary: Update global settings by key path

parameters.description: Map of settings key paths to values
parameters.name: request

get.description:
The live event stream of the WebUI (text/event-stream): every
event is a JSON object with type, timestamp, data and (for
replayable events) seq. A new connection first receives the
initial state and a replay of the recent slots.

Returns the slot's raw single-attestation arrivals grouped by
validator-ranges client name into fixed-width time buckets
from the slot start, plus per-name totals and the count of
attesters that landed on chain without being seen as singles.
Only slots still retained by the head vote tracker are served.
get.summary: Per-name head-vote arrival heatmap for a slot

parameters.description: Beacon block root (default: the slot's primary root)
parameters.name: root

parameters.description: Bucket width in ms (default slot_ms/24, clamped to [50, slot_ms])
parameters.name: bucket_ms

404.description: No vote detail retained for this slot

post.description:
Probes the EL RPC for the testing namespace now (instead of
waiting for the periodic check) and returns the resulting
availability. Requires authentication; audited.

get.description:
Returns whether the EL exposes testing_buildBlockV1 (probed),
the per-EL blob handling, the effective local build settings
and the transaction pool's availability and toggle state.

Runs the testing build's transaction selection with the live
settings — the inclusion list first, then the configured
transaction source (txpool, private_first or most_profitable)
— without building: for the block on the current head and,
while the current slot's block is not on chain yet, for the
slot after it, assuming our current slot candidate gets
included (its transactions out, their senders' nonces and
balances past them, the base fee after it). Public: the
aggregates; the transactions and pool hashes need a login.
Estimates are shared between viewers and pushed as the
next_block event.

404.description: Pool not configured or no head

get.description:
Returns a single-payload summary used by the multi-instance overview UI:
running state, builder pubkey, current slot, EL client info, available/enabled
services, balances, and recent build stats.
get.summary: Get a compact overview of this buildoor instance

get.description:
The transactions of one of our recent payloads or of any
recent block on chain, in block order, with their origin
(inclusion list, private, public), effective tip and gas
used. A testing build's payload may hold private
transactions: before it is on chain it needs a login.

401.description: Testing build payload not on chain yet, without a login

get.description: Returns all builder preferences currently in the cache, submitted by proposers via the submitBuilderPreferences API.
Returns all proposer preferences currently in the cache, received via P2P gossip.
Returns the list of validators registered via the Builder API (fee recipient preferences). Not paginated.
API keys (without secrets), per-caller call stats (anonymous per IP or shared, per key, static token, WebUI login) and the read upstreams. Requires authentication: the stats carry client IPs.

post.description: Creates an API key for the /rpc ingress. The secret is returned once and never stored (only its SHA-256). Send it as "X-API-Key: <key>", "Authorization: Bearer <key>" or in the URL as /rpc/<key>.

delete.description: Deletes the key; callers using it are refused from the next request on.

patch.description: Changes a key's label, enabled flag or rate limit. A disabled key is refused (401) without being deleted.

get.description:
Returns the recorded outcome history (build, bids, block
submissions, reveals, inclusion, applied plan) for every
active slot within the inclusive slot range.

parameters.description: summary = a compact record per slot (build status and headline fields, attempts, inclusion, tx plan) for overview grids
parameters.name: view

get.description:
Lists the metadata of every signed bid stored for the slot
(JSON only; fetch individual bids by index for SSZ). Returns
an empty list for slots without bid artifacts.
get.summary: List a slot's signed bid artifacts

get.description:
Returns one signed bid created for the slot, addressed by its
artifact index (see the bid listing endpoint). Pre-Gloas bids
are SignedBuilderBid, Gloas+ bids SignedExecutionPayloadBid.
Content negotiation as with the payload artifact endpoint.
get.summary: Get one signed bid of a slot

get.description:
Returns the signed execution payload envelope constructed for
the slot's reveal (stored at construction time, so failed
publishes remain inspectable). Content negotiation as with the
payload artifact endpoint.
get.summary: Get the signed payload envelope of a slot

get.description:
Returns the payload the slot's primary build target selected
last (the one that fed the bids), or with ?candidate= the
selection of that target. Every other payload the slot built
is served by block hash (payloads/{blockHash}). With
"Accept: application/octet-stream" the raw SSZ bytes are
served; otherwise a {"version", "data"} JSON envelope. The
Eth-Consensus-Version response header carries the fork name.
get.summary: Get the selected execution payload of a slot

parameters.description: Build-parent candidate key (parent_full, parent_empty, grandparent_full, grandparent_empty)
parameters.name: candidate

get.description:
Returns one execution payload built for the slot, addressed by
its block hash (the slot result's payloads, builds and
selections name payloads by it). The engine payload and every
selected payload are captured; a testing run's payload nobody
selected is not. Content negotiation as with the selected
payload endpoint.
get.summary: Get one of a slot's built payloads by block hash

404.description: No artifact for this block hash

get.description:
Returns builder statistics including slots built, bids submitted/won,
total paid, and reveal success/failure counts.

Returns the current builder status including running state, current slot,
builder index and public key.

Returns the pool's aggregate stats (pending count, senders, gas
sum, value, blobs, lifetime counters) and a page of queued
transactions.

delete.description: Clears the transaction pool. Requires authentication; audited.

get.description:
Returns the state of the mirror of the EL mempool's pending
transactions (the testing build's fill source) and a page of
its content. Public: these are the EL's public transactions.
Reading it never starts the mirror, which runs only while
builds use it.

Buckets the pending transactions of the EL mempool mirror by
max fee per gas (log scale) against the next base fee and the
block gas limit. buildoor's own (private) transactions are
included, as their own series, only for logged-in readers.

404.description: Pool not configured or no head

delete.description:
Removes the transaction with the given hash from the pool.
Requires authentication; audited.

get.description: Returns the current version

bid_candidate.description:
BidCandidate overrides which built candidate payload this slot's p2p
bids commit to: auto, all, or a specific candidate key.

bid_keys_per_slot.description:
BidKeysPerSlot overrides how many distinct builder keys may bid this
slot (0 = no cap beyond the fleet).

bid_keys_per_step.description:
BidKeysPerStep overrides how many keys bid a payload per interval step
(0 = every remaining key at once).

bid_value_gwei.description:
BidValueGwei is an absolute bid base value replacing
max(blockValue, min) + subsidy; BidIncrease still applies per re-bid.
Allows underbidding the block value for testing.

ignore_missing_prefs.description:
IgnoreMissingPrefs bids with the payload's fee recipient when no gossip
proposer preferences arrived for the slot, bypassing the skip gate.

key_strategy.description:
KeyStrategy overrides which managed builder key signs this slot's bids:
round_robin, single, random or least_used.

candidates.description:
Candidates overrides the global build-candidate policy for this slot:
candidate key (parent_full, parent_empty, grandparent_full,
grandparent_empty) -> mode (auto, always, never). Absent keys inherit
the global policy.

inclusion_list.description:
InclusionList overrides the inclusion list (FOCIL, Heze) handling for
this slot; absent = inherit build.inclusion_list_mode/_bits.

local.description:
Local overrides the local build extension (testing_buildBlockV1) for
this slot; absent = inherit the global local_build settings. The EL's
availability of the testing namespace still wins at build time.

reorg_parent_payload.description:
ReorgParentPayload builds on the grandparent (n-2) execution payload
instead of the immediate parent: the FCU head block hash and the payload
attributes' withdrawals are taken from the PARENT slot's payload
attributes (whose parent is n-2), while every other property comes from
the current slot. This is a deliberate parent-payload reorg attempt —
rejected by mainnet forkchoice, but useful for exercising the reveal /
inclusion path against a withheld parent.

execution_payment_gwei.description:
ExecutionPaymentGwei replaces the global execution-payment portion for
this slot: the absolute part of the served total value claimed as
execution_payment (unbacked; capped by the proposer's advertised
max_execution_payment unless ignore_preference_limit; wins over the
percent).

execution_payment_percent.description:
ExecutionPaymentPercent replaces the global percentage (0-100) of the
served total value claimed as execution_payment.

ignore_preference_limit.description:
IgnorePreferenceLimit serves this slot's execution-payment portion even
beyond the proposer's advertised max_execution_payment (deliberately
spec-violating).

key_strategy.description:
KeyStrategy overrides which managed builder key signs this slot's served
bids: round_robin, single, random or least_used.

respond_at_ms.description:
RespondAtMs overrides the global response gate (ms after the slot
start; 0 = respond immediately), see config.BuilderAPIConfig.

response_delay_ms.description:
ResponseDelayMs delays the bid response by this many milliseconds
(context-cancellable, capped at one slot).

serve_candidates.description:
ServeCandidates overrides which built candidate payloads bid requests
for this slot may be answered from: all, canonical_only, or a
comma-separated candidate key list.

total_value_override_gwei.description:
TotalValueOverrideGwei is the absolute total proposer-visible bid value
(before the Gloas execution-payment split), replacing block value +
subsidy. May exceed the block value to test payment edge cases.

value_subsidy_gwei.description:
ValueSubsidyGwei replaces the global BlockValueSubsidyGwei for this slot
(negative = margin, see config.BuilderAPIConfig.BlockValueSubsidyGwei).

bid.description:
Resolved effective settings; a nil category = suppressed for this slot
(by plan or by the global enable flags / protocol applicability).

build.description:
Build is the complete resolved build decision for the slot (schedule +
plan force/suppress). Always non-nil.

fork.description: fork name at the target slot

plan.description: raw sparse plan; nil = none existed

transforms.description:
Transforms carries the effective jq transform expressions (empty when no
transform plan applies). Nil only when no plan expression is set.

bits.description: Bits: view, all or none (see config.InclusionListBitsView).

omit_txs.description:
OmitTxs leaves these transactions (0x hashes) out of the slot's
builds even in include mode: a payload censoring exactly them.

build_el_payload.description:
BuildELPayload runs (or skips) the engine-API build for the slot,
overriding build.engine_enabled.

enabled.description: Enabled forces the local build on or off for the slot.

queued.description:
Queued is the exact ordered list of transaction hashes (0x-hex) the
slot's local payload is built from; every hash must be queued in the
pool at build time and the order must respect each sender's nonces.
Implies tx_source queued. Any deviation fails the build, never trims.

transactions.description:
Transactions is the exact raw transaction list (0x-hex, network
encoding) the slot's local payload is built from.

transactions_redacted.description:
TransactionsRedacted is the length of Transactions when the list was
hidden from a reader without a login (output only).

tx_source.description:
TxSource: txpool | private_first | most_profitable | empty |
el_mempool | explicit (explicit requires Transactions; a non-empty
Transactions list implies explicit).

ignore_rules.description:
IgnoreRules is two-state on purpose: absent = unchanged, true/false =
set the slot's recurring-rule opt-out.

bid_candidate.description:
BidCandidate is the effective bid candidate selection for the slot:
auto, all, or a specific candidate key.

bid_keys_per_slot.description:
BidKeysPerSlot caps how many distinct builder keys bid the slot
(0 = no cap beyond the fleet).

bid_keys_per_step.description:
BidKeysPerStep is how many keys bid a payload per interval step
(0 = every remaining key at once).

forced.description:
Forced marks that the plan activated bidding although the module is
globally disabled.

ignore_missing_prefs.description: IgnoreMissingPrefs bids without gossip proposer preferences.

key_strategy.description:
KeyStrategy is the effective builder key selection strategy for the
slot's bids.

value_gwei.description:
ValueGwei, when set, is the absolute bid base value replacing the
max(blockValue, min) + subsidy formula (IncreaseGwei still applies).

build.description: Build is the final decision: build a payload for this slot or not.

build_start_time_ms.description:
BuildStartTimeMs is the effective build start time, milliseconds
relative to slot start (signed).

candidate_modes.description:
CandidateModes is the effective build-candidate policy for the slot:
candidate key -> auto/always/never, merged from the global config and
the plan's build.candidates overrides.

engine_enabled.description:
EngineEnabled runs the engine-API build for the slot: the global
build.engine_enabled, overridden by the plan's build.local
build_el_payload.

forced.description:
Forced marks builds the plan pushed past the schedule (they never
consume the next_n budget).

inclusion_list.description:
InclusionList is the effective inclusion list (FOCIL, Heze) handling:
the global build.inclusion_list_mode/_bits, overridden by the plan's
build.inclusion_list. Always non-nil.

local.description:
Local is the effective local build (testing_buildBlockV1) instruction,
merged from the global local_build/txpool settings and the plan's
build.local overrides. Always non-nil; Enabled=false when the extension
is off for the slot. The EL's runtime availability of the testing
namespace is checked by the builder, not here.

plan_involved.description:
PlanInvolved marks decisions where a per-slot plan existed or any
consumer was effectively active — i.e. skips worth surfacing.

reorg_parent_payload.description:
ReorgParentPayload builds the slot's payload on the grandparent (n-2)
execution payload instead of the immediate parent — a deliberate
parent-payload reorg attempt (see BuildPlan.ReorgParentPayload).

skip_reason.description:
SkipReason is one of the BuildSkipReason* constants when Build is
false, empty otherwise.

execution_payment_gwei.description:
ExecutionPaymentGwei / ExecutionPaymentPercent claim part of the served
total value as execution_payment (the trusted EL payment) instead of the
trustless on-chain value — an unbacked claim (testing knob). The absolute
amount wins over the percent; both 0 = the whole total goes via value.
The portion is capped by the proposer's advertised max_execution_payment
unless IgnorePreferenceLimit deliberately serves beyond it.

forced.description:
Forced marks that the plan activated serving although the module is
globally disabled.

key_strategy.description:
KeyStrategy is the effective builder key selection strategy for the
slot's served bids.

respond_at_ms.description:
RespondAtMs is the slot's response gate in ms after the slot start (0
= respond immediately): bid responses wait for it and then serve the
best payload built by then.

serve_candidates.description:
ServeCandidates is the effective serve-candidates policy for the slot
(all, canonical_only, or a comma-separated candidate key list).

total_value_gwei.description:
TotalValueGwei, when set, is the absolute total proposer-visible bid
value (before the Gloas execution-payment split).

omit_txs.description: OmitTxs are left out of the builds (0x hashes).

allow_blobs_without_bundle.description:
AllowBlobsWithoutBundle includes blob transactions on ELs whose testing
path returns no blobs bundle.

base_fee_ceiling_gwei.description:
BaseFeeCeilingGwei halves the fill above this next base fee (global-only,
0 = off; exact lists are never reduced).

forced.description:
Forced marks that the plan enabled the local build although it is
globally disabled.

max_attempts.description:
MaxAttempts / MaxStrikes are the retry policy of the txpool source
(global-only).

queued.description: Queued is the exact ordered hash list for the queued source.

start_time_ms.description:
StartTimeMs / EndTimeMs / RebuildIntervalMs time the testing builds
(global-only; see config.LocalBuildConfig).

transactions.description: Transactions is the explicit list (0x-hex) for the explicit source.

transactions_redacted.description:
TransactionsRedacted is the length of Transactions when the list was
hidden from a reader without a login (output only).

tx_source.description:
TxSource: txpool | private_first | most_profitable | empty |
el_mempool | explicit | queued.

broadcast_validation.description:
BroadcastValidation is the envelope submission's broadcast_validation
level: gossip | consensus | consensus_and_equivocation.

bypass_deadline.description:
BypassDeadline disables the "past the in-slot deadline → skip" check so
deliberately late reveals are attempted.

gate_mode.description:
GateMode decides the reveal moment: time | vote | vote_or_time |
vote_and_time.

max_attempts.description:
MaxAttempts / RetryIntervalMs are the publish retry policy
(global-only, no per-slot override).

vote_threshold_pct.description:
VoteThresholdPct is the participation threshold (percent) opening the
vote gate.

broadcast_validation.description:
BroadcastValidation overrides the envelope submission's broadcast
validation level: gossip | consensus | consensus_and_equivocation.

gate_mode.description:
GateMode overrides the reveal gate: time | vote | vote_or_time |
vote_and_time.

reveal_time_ms.description: RevealTimeMs is signed milliseconds relative to slot start (time gate).

vote_threshold_pct.description: VoteThresholdPct overrides the vote gate's participation threshold.

ignore_rules.description:
IgnoreRules opts the slot out of every recurring rule, so it runs on the
plain global baseline. Without it an empty plan is dropped, which would
hand the slot straight back to the matching rule.

rule_id.description:
RuleID marks a plan synthesized from a recurring rule. Synthesized plans
are never stored — the field is empty on every persisted plan.

from_epoch.description:
FromEpoch / ToEpoch bound the rule to an inclusive epoch window; nil is
unbounded on that side.

slots_in_epoch.description:
SlotsInEpoch are the matched slot indices within an epoch (0-based, so
31 is the last slot of a 32-slot epoch).

rate_limit.description: calls per second, 0 = unlimited; absent = default

plan_checks.description:
PlanChecks is the process-lifetime tally of post-inclusion checks of
locally built blocks (nil without an EL RPC).

version.description:
Version counts the estimate sets: the next_block event carries it, so
a logged-in reader fetches the transactions of exactly that set.

basis.description:
Basis is what the estimated block follows: head (a block on the
current head), candidate (the slot after our current slot candidate,
BasisBlock, assumed included) or head_only (the slot after a current
slot block nobody here built: nothing assumed).

local_build_enabled.description:
LocalBuildEnabled is false when the testing build is off: the estimate
then shows what it would select.

note.description:
Note explains an estimate that cannot be made (the source leaves the
choice to the EL, or builds empty blocks).

public_mempool.description:
PublicMempool is mirrored (the EL mempool is part of the estimate),
idle (the source takes it, but the mirror is not running: no build
asked for it lately) or unused (the source does not take it).

selection.description:
Selection carries the aggregates (counts, gas, blobs, skips and the
split by origin); its pool transaction hashes need a login.

slot.description:
Slot is the slot of the block that extends the current head (the slot
after the head, or the current slot after missed slots).

tx_source.description:
TxSource is the configured transaction source; Ordering the private
pool's order (private_first and txpool).

txs.description:
Txs are the block's transactions in block order (login only, at most
nextBlockMaxTxs).

gas_used.description: GasUsed is the gas the transaction used (on-chain blocks only).

tip.description: Tip is the effective priority fee per gas over the base fee, wei.

builder_index.description:
BuilderIndex is the on-chain registry index, only meaningful when
HasBuilderIndex is set (index 0 is a valid builder index).

indexes.description:
Indexes are the on-chain indexes of every key currently in the registry,
ascending. This is the field an indexer wants.

ours.description:
Ours marks one of our payloads (classified by its build's own
accounting); OnChain that the EL has the block.

txs.description:
Txs are in block order. Origin is inclusion_list (on the list the
block had to satisfy), private (from our private mempool) or public.

value.description:
Value is what the block pays its fee recipient in priority fees, wei:
our build's reported block value, or the effective tips times the gas
the transactions used (empty while unknown).

expression.description: Expression is the jq program to evaluate.

sample_slot.description:
SampleSlot, when > 0, sources the input from that slot's captured
artifact (falling back to a template when it is unavailable).

target.description: Target is one of payload | bid | envelope.

error.description: Error is the parse/eval error message (present when the expression fails).

input.description:
Input is the JSON the expression ran against (message JSON for bid /
envelope; the payload for payload), pretty-printed as a string.

output.description: Output is the transform result, pretty-printed (present when Error is empty).

ingress_path.description:
IngressPath is where generators submit transactions (relative to the
API base URL).

rate_limit.description:
RateLimit sets the key's own limit (calls per second, 0 = unlimited);
DefaultRateLimit returns it to txpool.rpc_key_rate.

builder_index.description:
BuilderIndex is the on-chain registry index; only meaningful when
HasBuilderIndex is set (index 0 is a valid builder index).

effective_balance_gwei.description:
EffectiveBalance is the balance the key can actually bid against:
chain balance plus local adjustments minus pending payments.

last_topup_epoch.description: LastTopupEpoch guards the per-key top-up cooldown (0 = never topped up).

pubkey.description: PubkeyHex is the 0x-prefixed public key, for JSON consumers.

use_count.description: UseCount is how many deposit generations this key has gone through.

num_private_txs.description:
NumPrivateTxs counts the transactions buildoor supplied itself (its
own mempool or an action plan's list); the rest came from the EL's
public mempool. Absent on records from before it was tracked.

bits.description: Bits are the committee bits of the view (hex in JSON).

lists.description:
Lists are the committee lists in the view (Timely of them on time);
Equivocators the members whose lists were ignored.

slot.description: Slot is the inclusion list slot (the payload's slot - 1).

transactions.description:
Transactions is the size of the view; Omitted those left out on
purpose (mode omit, or the plan's omit_txs).

available.description: Available is true when testing_buildBlockV1 answered the probe.

blob_bundle.description:
BlobBundle is false on ELs whose testing path returns an empty blobs
bundle (reth, ethrex).

blob_encoding.description: BlobEncoding is the effective blob transaction encoding for the EL.

checked_at.description: CheckedAt is the last probe time (zero before the first probe).

configured.description: Configured is true when an EL RPC client exists (--el-rpc).

el_code.description: ELCode is the EL's engine_getClientVersionV1 code (GE, RH, ...).

enable_hint.description: EnableHint is the EL flag that exposes the namespace.

attempts.description: Attempts is how many testing_buildBlockV1 calls the build took.

built_at.description: BuiltAt is when testing_buildBlockV1 returned the payload.

dropped.description:
Dropped lists the pool transactions removed from the attempt after an
attributed EL refusal (txpool source only), with the failure class.

dropped_by_el.description:
DroppedByEL counts submitted transactions the EL left out of the payload
(ELs that silently filter instead of failing the call).

expected_hashes.description:
ExpectedHashes are the hashes of the transactions handed to the EL, in
order (nil for the el_mempool source, where the EL chooses). The built
payload is checked against this list before it is used, and the
included block after inclusion.

explicit_txs.description: ExplicitTxs is the explicit list length (tx source explicit / queued).

fill_txs.description:
FillTxs is how many EL mempool transactions the private_first source
placed after the pool selection (most_profitable: among it); FillError
is why the EL mempool
could not be read (the build then used the pool alone); FillDropped
marks that the EL refused the list and the build retried without the
fill; FillBlobsDropped that a refused list was first retried without
the fill's blob transactions (and their senders' later fill txs).

inclusion_list.description:
InclusionList is the inclusion list view this build carried (nil
before Heze).

inclusion_list_dropped.description:
InclusionListDropped marks a payload without the slot's inclusion list
(a spec-violating payload): the build only succeeded after dropping it,
or the el_mempool source never carried it.

inclusion_list_txs.description:
InclusionListTxs is how many inclusion-list transactions the slot had
(prepended to the list, or ignored by the el_mempool source).

mirror_started.description:
MirrorStarted marks a selection that started the EL mempool mirror
(a full read): untypically slow, so it does not train the timing model.

run.description: Run is the run's number within its target (1-based).

selection.description: Selection is the pool selection summary (tx source txpool).

started_at.description:
StartedAt is when the testing build began (its selection);
SelectedAt when the list was assembled and the testing call started.

submitted_txs.description:
SubmittedTxs is how many transactions were handed to the EL (-1 for the
el_mempool source, where the EL chooses).

artifact_index.description:
ArtifactIndex references the slot's stored 'bid' SSZ artifact; nil when
no artifact exists (suppressed, pre-construction failure, or capture
disabled/failed).

competitor_high_gwei.description:
CompetitorHighGwei is the highest known competitor bid at submission
time (p2p only, our own builder index excluded).

key_index.description:
KeyIndex is the internal builder key the bid was signed with, resolved
from BuilderIndex at record time. Recorded because a builder index is
reused by other builders after an exit, so the mapping is only reliable
while the bid is being made.

calls.description: Calls times the engine build's calls.

info.description: Info is the testing run's transaction assembly.

payload_hash.description: PayloadHash names the build's own payload (ready).

attributes.description: Attributes is the payload_attributes snapshot the target built from.

candidate.description:
Candidate classifies the parent tuple (parent_full, parent_empty,
grandparent_full, grandparent_empty; empty = unclassified).

tx_source.description:
Testing request: the testing builds' tx and payload source, or why
none ran although the slot asked for them.

num_private_txs.description:
NumPrivateTxs counts the transactions buildoor supplied itself (own
mempool or plan list); absent on records from before it was tracked.

payload_check_slot.description: PayloadCheckSlot is the follow-up block's slot the verdict came from.

payload_status.description:
PayloadStatus is the canonical verdict for the won payload: pending
until the first follow-up block is seen, then canonical or missed based
on that block's committed parent execution hash. Pre-Gloas wins are
canonical immediately (the payload is embedded in the block).

captured.description:
Captured marks that the payload is stored as an artifact (the engine
payload and every selected one).

inclusion_list.description:
InclusionList is the inclusion list view (FOCIL, Heze) the payload
was built against.

started_at.description:
StartedAt is when the attempt began (envelope construction + submit
call); nil on skips where nothing was attempted.

fallback.description:
Fallback marks an engine payload picked because no testing payload the
payload source asked for existed (yet).

error.description: Error is the primary target's error when the slot failed.

applied_plan.description: AppliedPlan is the frozen plan snapshot the slot executed under.

build.description: Build is the slot's build lifecycle with every target it ran.

dropped_attempts.description:
DroppedAttempts counts attempts beyond the per-kind retention cap,
keyed by kind ("bids", "block_submissions", "reveal_attempts").

payloads.description: Payloads holds every payload built for the slot, by block hash.

tx_plan.description:
TxPlan is the post-inclusion verdict of a locally built payload: whether
the canonical block holds exactly the transactions buildoor submitted,
in order. Only set for included slots whose payload came from an
explicit list (local build with a txpool/explicit/queued source).

mirror_active.description:
MirrorActive: the EL mempool part is current (the mirror runs only
while builds use it).

private.description: Private: the pool's transactions are included (logged-in readers).

active.description: Active: the mirror runs (a build used it within the idle timeout).

arrivals.description: arrivals clearing the latest base fee

cold_txs.description:
ColdTxs are far below the base fee: only their facts are kept, the
body is refetched from the EL once the base fee comes close.

mode.description:
Mode is how arrivals come in: websocket (live), filter (polled) or
resync (full reads only, the EL has no filters).

tips.description:
Tips is the effective tip times the gas limit, summed, in wei: the
most the origin's transactions can pay the builder (they pay for the
gas they use).

cold.description:
Cold counts the transactions far below the base fee whose bodies wait
in the store instead of memory.

fill_candidates.description: EL mempool fill (tx sources private_first, most_profitable).

inclusion_list_skipped.description:
InclusionListSkipped counts the list's transactions that could not
execute, by reason.

origins.description: Origins accounts the block's transactions by where they came from.
